description: This file defines the internal sealed partial class 'CallbackData' within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It manages callback handling for message responses, including cancellation, timeout, and failure scenarios, and contains methods for response processing and logging.

classes.name: CallbackData
classes.description: Manages callback data for message responses, including handling cancellation, timeout, failure, and response processing within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: CallbackData
methods.description: Constructor initializing callback data with shared context, response completion source, and message.

methods.name: SubscribeForCancellation
methods.description: Subscribes to a cancellation token to handle cancellation requests.

methods.name: SignalCancellation
methods.description: Signals cancellation to the shared cancellation manager.

methods.name: OnStatusUpdate
methods.description: Updates the last known status response.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the callback has expired based on the current timestamp.

methods.name: GetResponseTimeoutStopwatchTicks
methods.description: Calculates the response timeout in stopwatch ticks based on message or shared settings.

methods.name: GetResponseTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the default response timeout as a TimeSpan.

methods.name: OnCancellation
methods.description: Handles cancellation logic, signals remote, unregisters, and completes the response with an OperationCanceledException.

methods.name: OnTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout scenario, unregisters, logs, and completes the response with a TimeoutException.

methods.name: OnTargetSiloFail
methods.description: Handles target silo failure, unregisters, logs, and completes the response with a SiloUnavailableException.

methods.name: DoCallback
methods.description: Completes the response callback with the received message.

methods.name: ResponseCallback
methods.description: Processes the response message, handling success, rejection, and exceptions.

methods.name: LogTargetSiloFail
methods.description: Logs a target silo failure warning message.
